# Aydin Ayanzadeh

> Official personal site of Aydin Ayanzadeh, Ph.D. student in Computer Science at the University of Maryland, Baltimore County (UMBC). Research focuses on computer vision, medical image analysis, multimodal / vision-language models, and accessibility AI.

## Canonical identity
- Name: Aydin Ayanzadeh
- Website: https://www.ayanzadeh.com/
- ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8816-3204
- Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=B17tai4AAAAJ
- Email: a.ayanzadeh@gmail.com / aydina1@umbc.edu

## Publications
<!-- build:publications -->
- [Modular Deep Learning Mechanisms for Auditable Next-Day Wildfire Spread Prediction](https://www.ayanzadeh.com/nextday-wildfire/): arXiv 2026. Modular deep learning augmentations for next-day wildfire spread prediction: wind- and slope-conditioned attention, retrieval-augmented correction, and dual-stream gating.
- [Characterizing an On-Device Depth-Aware Multimodal Workload in Assistive Navigation for Blind and Low-Vision Users](https://www.ayanzadeh.com/iiswc-2026-workload/): IISWC 2026. An end-to-end characterization of an on-device, depth-aware multimodal workload for assistive indoor navigation for blind and low-vision users.
- [LLM-Guided Agentic Floor Plan Parsing for Accessible Indoor Navigation of Blind and Low-Vision People](https://www.ayanzadeh.com/cvpr-2026-floorplan-agentic/): CVPR 2026 Workshop (GRAIL-V). An agentic framework that converts a single floor plan image into a structured, retrievable knowledge base for safe, accessible indoor navigation.
- [WildfireVLM: AI-Powered Analysis for Early Wildfire Detection Using Satellite Imagery](https://www.ayanzadeh.com/wildfirevlm-page/): IGARSS 2026. A vision-language model for early wildfire detection and risk assessment from satellite imagery.
- [Floorplan2Guide: LLM-Guided Floorplan Parsing for BLV Indoor Navigation](https://www.ayanzadeh.com/IEEEBigData2025/): IEEE BigData 2025. Floorplan2Guide transforms floorplans into spatial knowledge graphs and language-guided indoor navigation for blind and low-vision users.
- [PURSUhInT: In Search of Informative Hint Points Based on Layer Clustering for Knowledge Distillation](https://www.ayanzadeh.com/pursuhint/): Expert Systems with Applications, 2023. A clustering-based hint selection method for knowledge distillation: teacher layers are clustered and the cluster centers become the hint points.
- [Automated analysis of phase-contrast optical microscopy time-lapse images: application to wound healing and cell motility assays of breast cancer](https://www.ayanzadeh.com/wound-healing-microscopy-chapter/): Book chapter, Academic Press, 2023. An end-to-end workflow for analyzing phase-contrast microscopy data from cell motility and wound healing assays.
- [Improved cell segmentation using deep learning in label-free optical microscopy images](https://www.ayanzadeh.com/cell-segmentation-microscopy/): Turkish Journal of Electrical Engineering and Computer Sciences, 2021. A modified U-Net with a pretrained ResNet-18 encoder, residual decoder blocks, and a redesigned skip-connection for cell segmentation in label-free microscopy images.
- [Representation learning using graph autoencoders with residual connections](https://www.ayanzadeh.com/resvgae-graph-autoencoders/): arXiv 2021. Residual connections for deep graph autoencoders: ResVGAE, a deep variational graph autoencoder with multiple residual modules, for link prediction.
- [Deep Learning based Segmentation Pipeline for Label-Free Phase-Contrast Microscopy Images](https://www.ayanzadeh.com/siu-2020-segmentation-pipeline/): SIU 2020. A deep learning segmentation pipeline for label-free phase-contrast microscopy images, improving U-Net and FPN with an ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-18 encoder.
- [Graph Embedding For Link Prediction Using Residual Variational Graph Autoencoders](https://www.ayanzadeh.com/siu-2020-graph-embedding/): SIU 2020. Residual Variational Graph Autoencoder (RVGAE): residual connections boost variational graph autoencoders for link prediction.
- [A New Class of Scaling Matrices for Scaled Trust Region Algorithms](https://www.ayanzadeh.com/scaling-matrices-trust-region/): arXiv 2019. A new class of affine scaling matrices for interior point Newton-type methods, defined as a convex combination of well-known scaling matrices.
- [Cell Segmentation of 2D Phase-Contrast Microscopy Images with Deep Learning Method](https://www.ayanzadeh.com/tiptekno-2019-cell-segmentation/): TIPTEKNO 2019. A multiresolution U-Net with multi-combination augmentation for cell segmentation in 2D phase-contrast microscopy images.
- [Automated Segmentation of Cells in Phase Contrast Optical Microscopy Time Series Images](https://www.ayanzadeh.com/tiptekno-2019-cell-time-series/): TIPTEKNO 2019. Traditional image processing and deep learning approaches for automated cell segmentation from phase-contrast microscopy time series, evaluated against manually annotated datasets.
- [Modified Deep Neural Networks for Dog Breeds Identification](https://www.ayanzadeh.com/dog-breeds-identification/): Preprints 2018. Fine-tuned pretrained ImageNet models for dog breed identification, reaching 89.66% test accuracy on the Stanford Dogs dataset.
- [A Modified Ant colony Based Approach to Digital Image Edge Detection](https://www.ayanzadeh.com/ant-colony-edge-detection/): KBEI 2015. A modified ant colony optimization method for digital image edge detection, faster and more efficient than former ant colony based methods.
- [Gaussian Three-Dimensional kernel SVM for Edge Detection Applications](https://www.ayanzadeh.com/gaussian-svm-edge-detection/): Conference 2015 · arXiv 2017. A support vector machine with a three-dimensional Gaussian radial basis function kernel for edge detection, outperforming Canny and Sobel detectors.
<!-- /build:publications -->
